result.instructions: Tools for Kinde, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kinde data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run kinde_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kinde_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kinde_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. kinde_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kinde_get_business
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Fetch the Kinde business this token belongs to — its name, industry and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the credentials and audience are right. Kinde: GET /api/v1/business.

tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the business, optionally narrowed by email or user id. Kinde: GET /api/v1/users.

next_token.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_token. Omit for the first page.
